title: release.json
description: The manifest that a release publishes as a release asset, so a deployment reads what the release contains without the repo's source tree. format rises only on a change that a reader of the format before would misread.

format.description: The version of this manifest shape.

version.description: The release version, as semver without a leading v.

tag.description: The git tag of the release, in the repo's own tag form, such as v1.2.0 or @scope/name@1.2.0.

commit.description: The full SHA-1 of the commit that the release builds.

images.description: The container images that a deployment runs, by name.

sandboxImages.description: The images that the release's own services pull at run time, which a host must have before a rollout.

migrations.description: The database migrations that the release adds since the release before.

since.description: The tag of the release before, or null for the first release.

readableByReleaseBefore.description: Whether the release before can read the schema that this release leaves; null for the first release.

configSchema.description: The JSON Schema for the release's config, published as a separate release asset.

asset.description: The file name of the schema among the release's assets.

since.description: The tag of the release before, or null for the first release that publishes the schema.

breaking.description: Each config change since that release that a config valid before can fail.

imageRef.description: An image pinned by digest, as <registry>/<repository>[:<tag>]@sha256:<digest>.
